caption: The drawing depicts a circular plate set against a plain beige background. The plate has a thin red rim and a light gray border adorned with a repeated pattern of the alphabet in capital letters. Inside the border, there is an inscription: "MAKE HAY WHILE THE SUN SHINES" at the top and "FAMILIAR PROVERBS" at the bottom. In the center of the plate is a rural scene featuring a yellow haystack, two cows (one white with black spots and the other appears similarly colored), green grass, several trees with green foliage, and a blue stream or patch in the lower part of the image. The sky is depicted with light gray clouds and a large yellow sun positioned above the scene. The drawing utilizes soft colors, mainly yellow, green, blue, gray, and red accents, with black outlines to define the details.
title: Plate
